title: Interacting Quantum Atoms Method for Crystalline Solids
summary:
an implementation of the interacting quantum atoms method for crystals is presented . 
 it provides a real spaceenergy decomposition of the energy of crystals in which all energy
components are physically meaningful . the new package ChemIntables one to compute intra- and inter - atomic energies , as well as electron population measures used for quantitative description of chemical bonds in crystals .    * keywords : * quantum mechanics , quantum chemistry , crystal structure , chemical bonding , ionic and covalent interactions , interatomic interactions , quantum theory of atoms in molecules in molecules ( qtaim )
key_findings: Implementation of the interacting quantum atoms method for crystals
Real space energy decomposition of crystal energy components
Development of ChemIntables for computing atomic energies and electron population measures
methodology: The study presents an implementation of the interacting quantum atoms method specifically tailored for crystalline solids, utilizing a new software package called ChemIntables.
limitations: Focuses primarily on crystalline solids, limiting applicability to other structures
May require extensive computational resources for large systems
Potential challenges in interpreting complex energy components
future_work: Expand the method to non-crystalline materials
Enhance computational efficiency for larger systems
Investigate the implications of energy decomposition on chemical bonding in various materials
